title: 18S and 16S rRNA genes amplicon generation for eukaryotic and prokaryotic metabarcoding
author: Adriana Alberti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qwhdxb6
materials: Phusion High Fidelity PCR Master Mix with GC buffer
NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean-up kit

For generation of 18S barcodes, perform PCR amplifications with the Phusion High Fidelity PCR Master Mix with GC buffer (ThermoFisher Scientific) and the forward/reverse primer pair 1389F 5′- TTGTACACACCGCCC-3′ and 1510R 5′- CCTTCYGCAGGTTCACCTAC-3′ as described by Amaral-Zettler et al, 2009 . This primer pair yields a product of around 160 bp.

For generation of 16S barcodes, perform PCR amplifications with the Phusion High Fidelity PCR Master Mix with GC buffer (ThermoFisher Scientific) and the forward/reverse primer pair 515F-Y (5′- GTGYCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA-3′) and 926R (5′- CCGYCAATTYMTTTRAGTTT-3′) 16S described by Parada et al . This primer pair encompasses the V4 and V5 hypervariable regions, yielding a product of 400 bp.

steps.title: Choose target gene and method
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate case: 1) Eukaryotic 18S rRNA gene amplicon generation (Method ID: 18S_PCR) or 2) Prokaryotic 16S rRNA gene amplicon generation (Method ID: 16S_PCR).

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample prepare a 25 µL PCR reaction containing 5–10 ng total DNA template, 0.35 µM of each primer, 3 % DMSO, and 1× Phusion Master Mix. Set up each sample in triplicate to reduce intra‑sample variance and obtain sufficient material for Illumina sequencing.

steps.title: Run PCR with gene‑specific program
steps.instruction: Thermocycle the reactions using the program that matches the selected gene:

substeps.instruction: For 18S (Method 18S_PCR): 25 cycles of 10 s at 98 °C, 30 s at 57 °C, 30 s at 72 °C.
For 16S (Method 16S_PCR): 37 cycles of 10 s at 98 °C, 30 s at 53 °C, 30 s at 72 °C.

steps.title: Purify PCR products (gene‑specific)
steps.instruction: Clean the amplified DNA according to the target gene:

substeps.instruction: For 18S: Perform a modified 0.6× AMPure XP bead cleanup (Beckman Coulter Genomics). After DNA binds to the beads, retain the supernatant that contains larger fragments and further purify it using the NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean‑up kit (Macherey‑Nagel, Catalog #740609.10).
For 16S: Clean up the PCR product with 0.8× volume of Agencourt AMPure XP beads (contributed by users).

steps.title: Assess amplicon size and concentration
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of each purified amplicon on an Agilent Bioanalyzer with the DNA High Sensitivity LabChip kit to verify fragment length, and quantify the DNA using a Qubit Fluorometer.

steps.title: Construct Illumina library (gene‑specific)
steps.instruction: Use 100 ng of purified amplicon to prepare a standard Illumina library, omitting the initial DNA fragmentation step.

substeps.instruction: For 16S: After library amplification, perform a post‑amplification gel size‑selection, excising 500–650 bp gel slices (the amplicon size increased by Illumina adapters) to isolate the correct 16S product and remove non‑specific bands.
